sourceTitle: Teamwork — Turn Your Teams Inside Out
issue: MIT Sloan Management Review, Winter 2023, Vol. 64, No. 2

excludedItems.reason: 词义直接，可由常见单词组合理解。保留更具体的跨界协作概念。

items.meaning: 分布式领导
items.definitionEn: A pattern in which leadership responsibilities are shared across people and levels.
items.usage: 领导职责可随任务和专业需要在多人之间分配。
items.exampleEn: Distributed leadership allowed different engineers to lead each phase of the project.
items.exampleZh: 分布式领导让不同工程师能够分别主导项目的各个阶段。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 有创业精神的；主动探索机会的
items.definitionEn: Willing to spot opportunities, experiment, and act under uncertainty.
items.usage: 既可形容创业者，也可形容成熟机构内部主动尝试的团队。
items.exampleEn: The division gave an entrepreneurial team six weeks to test a new service.
items.exampleZh: 部门给一支富有创业精神的团队六周时间试验一项新服务。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 外向型协作团队；X 型团队
items.definitionEn: A team that combines internal collaboration with active learning and coordination across its boundaries.
items.usage: 文章中的 x 指 external，强调联系团队内外的利益相关者。
items.exampleEn: The x-team consulted suppliers and users while refining the design internally.
items.exampleZh: 这支外向型协作团队一边在内部完善设计，一边征求供应商和用户的意见。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 主动对外联络
items.definitionEn: Deliberate contact with people or groups outside a team or organization.
items.usage: 强调主动建立联系，可用于访谈用户、寻找专家或争取合作。
items.exampleEn: The launch team assigned two members to handle external outreach.
items.exampleZh: 上线团队安排两名成员负责主动对外联络。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 摆脱；去除不必要的东西
items.definitionEn: To get rid of something unwanted or burdensome.
items.usage: 常用于 shed bureaucracy、shed layers 等搭配，表示主动减去组织负担。
items.exampleEn: The unit shed two layers of approval to speed up routine decisions.
items.exampleZh: 该部门去掉两层审批，以加快日常决策。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 灵活敏捷的；反应快的
items.definitionEn: Able to adapt and respond quickly when conditions change.
items.usage: 形容组织时突出调整行动的速度。
items.exampleEn: A nimble procurement team can switch suppliers when a delivery fails.
items.exampleZh: 反应敏捷的采购团队能在交货失败时更换供应商。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 基础构件；基本组成单元
items.definitionEn: A basic unit that can be combined with others to create something larger.
items.usage: 常用比喻义，表示形成体系、战略或能力的基本单元。
items.exampleEn: Short customer interviews became the building blocks of our research plan.
items.exampleZh: 简短的客户访谈成了研究计划的基本组成单元。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 过时的；已不适用的
items.definitionEn: No longer useful or appropriate because conditions have changed.
items.usage: 比 old 更明确地指出某种假设或流程与当下脱节。
items.exampleEn: The merger exposed outmoded assumptions about how approvals should work.
items.exampleZh: 这次合并暴露出人们对审批方式的过时假设。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 惯性；维持旧做法的倾向
items.definitionEn: A tendency to remain in an existing state or continue familiar practices.
items.usage: 组织语境通常指即使环境改变，习惯和制度仍难以改变。
items.exampleEn: Organizational inertia kept the outdated reporting process in place for years.
items.exampleZh: 组织惯性使过时的报告流程延续了多年。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 使人联想到；在脑海中唤起
items.definitionEn: To make an image or idea appear in someone's mind.
items.usage: 常搭配 image、memory，表示引发鲜明联想；也常见 conjure up。
items.exampleEn: The phrase central office conjures an image of decisions made far from customers.
items.exampleZh: “总部”一词令人联想到远离客户的决策场所。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 可渗透的；允许跨越的
items.definitionEn: Allowing people, information, or influence to pass through a boundary.
items.usage: 本文比喻团队边界允许外部成员、信息和资源流动。
items.exampleEn: A permeable boundary lets the design team bring in specialists for short periods.
items.exampleZh: 开放的团队边界让设计团队能在短期内引入专业人员。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 使脱离原位；打破根深蒂固的观念
items.definitionEn: To remove something firmly established from its position.
items.usage: 比喻用法常见于观念、惯例或权力位置的改变。
items.exampleEn: One pilot project was enough to dislodge the belief that customers wanted a longer form.
items.exampleZh: 一次试点就打破了“客户想要更长表单”这一根深蒂固的看法。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 想成为某种身份的；有志于成为的
items.definitionEn: Hoping or trying to become the kind of person or thing named.
items.usage: 常置于名词前，表明身份或目标尚在形成。
items.exampleEn: A would-be market entrant must learn which regulations apply.
items.exampleZh: 一家准备进入市场的企业必须了解适用的法规。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 构思；生成创意的过程
items.definitionEn: The process of developing possible ideas or solutions.
items.usage: 设计与创新语境常指形成候选想法的阶段。
items.exampleEn: The facilitator separated ideation from evaluation during the workshop.
items.exampleZh: 主持人在研讨会上把创意构思与评估分开进行。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 商业生态系统
items.definitionEn: A network of interdependent firms, users, suppliers, and institutions around an activity or market.
items.usage: 强调共同影响机会和约束的参与者网络。
items.exampleEn: Payment providers and regulators are part of the company's business ecosystem.
items.exampleZh: 支付服务商和监管机构都是该公司商业生态系统的一部分。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 向某人简要介绍情况
items.definitionEn: To give someone essential information about a situation or task.
items.usage: 动词常用 brief someone on something，适用于会前说明或情况汇报。
items.exampleEn: The analyst briefed the board on the latest customer interviews.
items.exampleZh: 分析师向董事会简要汇报了最新的客户访谈情况。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 理解局势；将零散线索整合成判断
items.definitionEn: The process of interpreting information and building an understanding of a changing situation.
items.usage: 本文指通过接触利益相关者和观察环境形成可供团队讨论的判断。
items.exampleEn: Sensemaking helped the team connect three seemingly unrelated customer complaints.
items.exampleZh: 梳理线索帮助团队发现三条看似无关的客户投诉之间的联系。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 团队代表工作；对外争取支持
items.definitionEn: Representing a team to stakeholders to secure support, resources, or agreement.
items.usage: 这里强调替团队与高层及关键合作者沟通。
items.exampleEn: Maya handled ambassadorship by explaining the pilot's goals to department heads.
items.exampleZh: 玛雅负责代表团队对外联络，向各部门负责人说明试点目标。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 任务协调
items.definitionEn: The organization of interdependent tasks, handoffs, and schedules across people or teams.
items.usage: 关注谁在何时交付什么、如何衔接，以及质量标准。
items.exampleEn: Weekly task coordination kept the research and engineering teams aligned on handoffs.
items.exampleZh: 每周的任务协调让研究团队与工程团队对交接安排保持一致。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 至关重要的；有决定性作用的
items.definitionEn: Important enough to strongly influence the outcome of something.
items.usage: 常见 pivotal to 或 pivotal for，也可修饰 role。
items.exampleEn: A clear handoff was pivotal to finishing the redesign on time.
items.exampleZh: 清楚的交接对于按时完成重新设计至关重要。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 认可与支持；对方案的认同
items.definitionEn: Support for an idea or plan from the people whose cooperation matters.
items.usage: 不可数名词，常见 get、gain、secure 或 obtain buy-in；也有无连字符拼写。
items.exampleEn: The team secured buy-in from finance before announcing the pilot.
items.exampleZh: 团队在宣布试点前取得了财务部门的认同与支持。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 灵活周旋；设法在限制中行动
items.definitionEn: To move or act skillfully around practical or organizational constraints.
items.usage: 比喻用法强调在复杂限制中寻找可行路径。
items.exampleEn: The coordinator maneuvered around scheduling constraints to keep all three teams involved.
items.exampleZh: 协调员灵活处理排期限制，让三个团队都能参与。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 只在项目某一阶段参与的
items.definitionEn: Participating for only part of a team's life cycle.
items.usage: 强调参与时段；part-time 主要描述投入的工时比例。
items.exampleEn: A part-cycle member joined for the testing phase and left after launch.
items.exampleZh: 一名阶段性成员在测试阶段加入，并于上线后离开。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 先对外探索，再内部定任务
items.definitionEn: To learn from the external environment before settling the team's goals, roles, or task.
items.usage: 这是 X 型团队的工作原则，先从用户、专家和其他利益相关者处了解情况。
items.exampleEn: We decided to go out before in and interviewed users before drafting the project brief.
items.exampleZh: 我们决定先对外探索，在起草项目说明前先访谈用户。
collocations: use the go out before in approach

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 亲自参与的；重实践的
items.definitionEn: Involving direct practical participation in the work.
items.usage: 常形容培训、管理和执行方式，突出实际动手。
items.exampleEn: The manager took a hands-on approach to the first customer trials.
items.exampleZh: 经理亲自参与了最初的客户试用工作。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 耗时的活动；吞噬时间的事
items.definitionEn: An activity that consumes a disproportionate amount of time.
items.usage: 带批评意味，常形容反复开会、手工协调等低效投入。
items.exampleEn: Tracking minor edits in three separate systems became a time sink.
items.exampleZh: 在三个系统里分别跟踪细微修改成了一件特别耗时的事。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 模糊的边界
items.definitionEn: A boundary whose membership or limits are difficult to define precisely.
items.usage: 这里指成员可能仅参与部分任务，团队内外的归属并非固定。
items.exampleEn: The partnership has fuzzy boundaries because staff move in and out as needed.
items.exampleZh: 这项合作的成员边界比较模糊，因为员工按需要加入或退出。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 划定界限；明确区分
items.definitionEn: To mark or define the limits of a group, role, or area.
items.usage: 比 define 更侧重明确边界，常用于成员、职责和区域。
items.exampleEn: The charter demarcates the responsibilities of the two project leads.
items.exampleZh: 项目章程划清了两位项目负责人的职责。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 网络型成员；按需提供外部贡献的成员
items.definitionEn: A contributor in the wider organization or ecosystem who supports the team when needed.
items.usage: X 型团队中的网络型成员可按需提供资源和专业意见；核心成员维持连续性，执行成员负责当期任务。
items.exampleEn: A networked member from legal reviewed the proposal when the team needed specialist advice.
items.exampleZh: 团队需要专业意见时，法务网络中的一位协作成员审查了方案。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 帮助新成员融入并熟悉工作
items.definitionEn: To help someone join a team and learn how to participate effectively.
items.usage: 用作动词时，可直接接员工、成员或客户。
items.exampleEn: We onboard new contributors by pairing them with an experienced teammate.
items.exampleZh: 我们给新加入的贡献者安排一位有经验的搭档，帮助他们融入。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 替代性学习；通过他人经验学习
items.definitionEn: Learning by observing or drawing on someone else's experience.
items.usage: 这里指团队借鉴专家和其他团队已有的经验。
items.exampleEn: The apprentices gained vicarious learning opportunities by observing experienced technicians.
items.exampleZh: 学徒通过观察经验丰富的技术人员获得了借鉴他人经验的学习机会。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 原型制作；制作试验版本
items.definitionEn: The process of building early versions of an idea so they can be tested.
items.usage: 可用于产品、流程或服务试验，重点是尽早得到反馈。
items.exampleEn: Rapid prototyping revealed that the control panel confused first-time users.
items.exampleZh: 快速制作原型发现，初次使用者很难看懂控制面板。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 成果向外移交或推广
items.definitionEn: The stage of transferring a team's work and know-how to other groups that will develop or use it.
items.usage: 本文借用出口的含义，指把成果与经验交给后续部门。
items.exampleEn: During exportation, the pilot team trained the regional offices to run the new process.
items.exampleZh: 在成果移交阶段，试点团队培训各地区办事处使用新流程。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 战略一致性；目标与战略的对齐
items.definitionEn: Agreement between a team's priorities and the wider organization's strategic goals.
items.usage: 常用于确认具体项目如何支持组织更高层次的目标。
items.exampleEn: The review checked strategic alignment before the committee funded the project.
items.exampleZh: 委员会拨款前，审查了项目与组织战略是否一致。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 后续影响；负面反响
items.definitionEn: An indirect and often unwelcome consequence of an action or event.
items.usage: 常用复数 repercussions，强调由某事引起的后续连锁影响。
items.exampleEn: Staff raised concerns once they knew there would be no repercussions.
items.exampleZh: 员工确认提出疑虑不会招致负面后果后，便表达了自己的顾虑。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 让团队活动按节奏交替进行
items.definitionEn: To alternate periods of concentrated team interaction with periods of separate work.
items.usage: 本文用 pulse 比喻团队集中协作与分头完成任务的周期。
items.exampleEn: We pulse team activity by holding joint design sessions on Mondays and leaving two days for individual work.
items.exampleZh: 我们在周一集中设计，随后留出两天各自工作，让团队协作按节奏交替进行。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 建立牢固的关系；结成紧密联系
items.definitionEn: To build strong relationships or connections through effort or shared experiences.
items.usage: 本文用于建立社会联系，常与 bonds、ties 或 partnerships 搭配。
items.exampleEn: The joint assignment helped the teams forge strong bonds.
items.exampleZh: 这项共同任务帮助两个团队建立了牢固的联系。

duplicateDecision.reason: 本篇具体使用 forge bonds 的被动式，保留已有搭配原卡，累计来源。

items.meaning: 将经验整理成明确规则或流程
items.definitionEn: To put practices, knowledge, or rules into a structured and documented form.
items.usage: 组织管理中常指把团队经验变成可传承、可重复的流程。
items.exampleEn: The operations group codified its emergency response process in a shared guide.
items.exampleZh: 运营组把应急响应流程整理成了一份共享指南。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 概念验证；可行性验证
items.definitionEn: A small test or demonstration that shows an idea can work in principle.
items.usage: 可用于正式开发前验证核心设想，复数为 proofs of concept。
items.exampleEn: The team built a proof of concept before requesting money for a full system.
items.exampleZh: 团队先做了概念验证，再为完整系统申请资金。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 释放；使潜能充分发挥
items.definitionEn: To free an ability or force so that it can have its full effect.
items.usage: 积极管理语境常用于 talent、creativity 或 potential。
items.exampleEn: Giving frontline staff more discretion can unleash talent across the organization.
items.exampleZh: 给一线员工更多自主决定权能让全组织的人才充分发挥潜能。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。
